name: Billionaire
overview: Bahador, a simple young man with many scientific achievements, goes for an interview at a company that is run based on family and kinship ties. Mr. Farjam, the company's CEO, who is unhappy with this situation, asks Bahador to work in parallel with one of his wife's relatives and to do his best during this time so that after a week, whoever performs better will be hired. But Farjam's wife, who has a lot of influence in the company and most of the employees there are relatives, makes things difficult for Bahador...
